features.title: WhatsApp Notifications
features.description: Send instant notifications via WhatsApp messages. Keep your customers and team informed in real-time through the world's most popular messaging platform.

features.title: Contact Segments
features.description: Organize your contacts into segments for targeted messaging. Send custom messages to specific segments based on customer preferences, location, or behavior.

features.title: Scheduled Messages
features.description: Schedule WhatsApp messages to be sent at specific times. Plan your communications in advance and never miss an important notification.

features.title: Action-Triggered Messages
features.description: Automatically send WhatsApp notifications when specific actions occur, such as new orders, status updates, or system events. Set it and forget it.

features.title: Powerful Backend API
features.description: Robust backend infrastructure that handles all WhatsApp message delivery. Reliable, scalable, and built for high-volume notifications.

features.title: Shopify Integration
features.description: Upcoming Shopify plugin for seamless integration. Connect your store and send automated WhatsApp notifications for orders, shipping updates, and more.
